scope: Prepared Founder cash scenario workbench and tab-only account isolation; fictional local QA

checks: Blank required assumptions remain unknown; comparison and preview stay unavailable.
Independent hand calculations match both cards and every exact monthly cash movement.
Keyboard-focusable preview pins exact dated text; double activation preserves the original note and adds one summary, then disables repeat.
Changing an input invalidates its old preview; the new downside first becomes negative in month 2 and does not rewrite saved notes.
An oversized append leaves the entire existing note and pinned preview intact; the separate downloaded text file matches the preview byte-for-byte.
Restore cancellation preserves current notes; confirmed workbook replacement keeps raw scenario inputs and requires explicit keyboard adoption before another summary.
Workbook clear cancellation is harmless; confirmed clear does not erase the scenario and requires explicit adoption.
Raw scenario inputs survive stage changes and genuine in-app route navigation without reloading the document.
Calculator clear requires confirmation, supports cancellation and restores blank/default inputs while preserving workbook notes.
390px layout has no page/calculator overflow; the exact-values table scrolls within a focusable region and keyboard preview remains operable.
Actual provider identity switches isolate raw inputs and appended tab-only notes; A and B recover only their own work and require adoption.
Switching to a guest hides both accounts, and returning to B preserves B without copying the guest draft or note.
The actual confirmed-deletion exit callback clears B raw inputs and appended notes only; same-ID B is empty, A remains intact, and the guest draft survives. No deletion API is invoked.
No account or guest scenario/appended-note content enters localStorage or sessionStorage during the observed tab-only flows.

No external request, Founder account-workspace request, business mutation attempt or browser exception; measurement POSTs are explicit excluded no-ops and known Google font links use a recorded fixture-only system-font fallback.
browser.account_deletion: Actual local exit/cleanup callback only; no deletion API

corrected_findings: Tab-only account summary could cross identities; now separate memory per identity including guest.
Identity listener ordering could bind first calculator edit to stale context; layout subscription precedes identity change.
Workbook replacement displayed old preview before effect cleanup; now invalidated during render.

retained_failed_attempts.finding: Stale preview still visible during context-change render. Existing Google Fonts stylesheet attempt was blocked by the browser fixture.
Focus assertion ran before the intentional animation-frame callback; harness now waits for the exact focus target.
